messages.author: Ciarán Duggan
messages.body: Morning all. Vaccine fridge alarm was beeping away when I came in the back door. Ruth I see you've already been at it, can you give me the full picture on here when you get a minute. What happened, what's usable, what isn't, and what we change so it doesn't happen again. I'm ringing Munster Vet Supplies at 2 about credit so I need it before then.

messages.author: Aoife (reception)
messages.body: I've moved the 10.30 puppy vax (Bonnie, the cockapoo) to Wednesday just in case, owner was grand about it. Have 3 boosters this afternoon too, will I hold off on them as well??

messages.author: Marta Kowalczyk
messages.body: fwiw the seal on that door has been dodgy since the summer, you have to lean on it to get it to click. I mentioned it in July. Also the logger only beeps, nobody's here to hear it on a Sunday

messages.author: Ciarán Duggan
messages.body: Thanks both. Aoife yes hold the boosters until Ruth says otherwise. Ruth over to you, numbers and all please, I want to know exactly what the logger says and what the supplier told you. Don't sugar coat it.
